subtasks.title: Chip contrast: define chip colour tokens in theme.css and apply them to the Filament Select/TagsInput value chips and the hand-rolled ZIP chip + drawing banner
subtasks.approach: Operator decision #2 (CSS override, CHIPS ONLY) — the degenerate `primary` ramp in app/Support/Filament/PlatformPanelProvider.php:37-53 is NOT touched, so buttons and links do not shift in either panel. Instead, declare four chip custom properties once in resources/css/filament/app/theme.css and consume them from (a) the Filament Select multi-value badge and the TagsInput tag badge, scoped by their own container classes, and (b) the hand-rolled ZIP chip in manage-zones.blade.php. Verified layering fact that makes this safe and !important-free: vendor/filament/support/resources/css/index.css imports components/badge.css into `layer(components)` and utilities.css into `layer(utilities)`, while every rule this repo writes in theme.css sits AFTER the `@import` and is UNLAYERED — unlayered declarations beat every cascade layer regardless of specificity. So overriding `--text` / `--dark-text` (set by `.fi-text-color-600` / `dark:fi-text-color-200` on the badge element, utilities layer) and `background-color` (set by `.fi-badge.fi-color`'s `bg-color-50` / `dark:bg-color-400/10`, components layer) simply wins. The existing rules in this file already rely on that same mechanism.

subtasks.title: ZIP overlay: plain click selects and shows handles; first real vertex edit detaches the ZIP into definition.polygons
subtasks.approach: Operator decisions #1 (DETACH) and #3 (FULL HANDLES NOW). Two distinct google.maps event families keep 'select' and 'convert' apart, so a click can never destroy or convert anything. SELECT is the google.maps.Polygon `click` event — it only toggles overlay options. CONVERT is the MVCArray path events `set_at` / `insert_at` / `remove_at` on `polygon.getPath()` — the exact three already used by attachEditablePolygonHandlers (:560-567) — which can only fire when the geometry actually mutates (vertex dragged, midpoint handle dragged, vertex right-click-deleted). A click never writes to the MVCArray, so selection alone cannot trigger detach. Once detached, the overlay is an ordinary member of polygonOverlays, so syncEditingState() (:689-697) serialises it into definition.polygons and the ZIP is already gone from zipCodes — which means Zone::rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() no longer re-derives that ZIP from tiger_data.zcta5_all and the edited shape is authoritative on reload. No server, model, or schema change at all.

subtasks.title: Pin the DETACH definition shape at the Livewire/persistence boundary
subtasks.approach: The map interaction itself has no PHPUnit reachability — there is no JS test runner in this repo and the file's own docblock (:30-38) already delegates polygon drawing to Agent QA. What IS testable is the exact definition shape DETACH produces: a polygon in definition.polygons whose source ZIP is absent from definition.zip_codes. Two tests, following the file's existing patterns verbatim (ResourceTestCase, #[Group('clarity-scout')], Livewire::test(ManageZones::class), the private polygonDefinition()/makeZone() helpers). This is the only PHPUnit-shaped half of AC6, plus a cheap regression guard that the t1 styling work did not disturb the definition round-trip.

subtasks.title: Rebuild and commit public/build (without the Boost doc regeneration)
subtasks.approach: public/build is git-tracked (15 files under git ls-files public/build; .gitignore has no entry for it), and BOTH changed sources are Vite entry points — vite.config.js declares resources/css/filament/app/theme.css and resources/js/components/zone-manager.js in its input array. A source-only commit therefore ships as a production no-op: the browser keeps loading the old hashed assets. This is an explicit node, not an implicit step, because it is the single most common way this class of fix silently fails.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
Run `npm run build` (vite build && node scripts/version-sw.mjs && php artisan filament:assets)
from the worktree root, then commit the regenerated public/build/** (the theme and
zone-manager bundles get new content hashes, and public/build/manifest.json updates).

MANDATORY cleanup before committing: `npm run build` in this repo also regenerates the
Laravel Boost docs — it rewrites CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / the junie guidelines and drops a
boost.json. Those are NOT part of this ticket and re-inlining a <laravel-boost-guidelines>
block into CLAUDE.md is an okf-lint failure. `git checkout -- CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md` (plus any
junie file) and delete boost.json before staging, then `git status` must show ONLY
public/build/** in this node's diff.

Verification: confirm the new theme CSS bundle contains the string
`fi-select-input-value-badges-ctn` and the new zone-manager bundle contains `detachZip` —
grep the built files, do not assume the build picked the changes up.

DRIVER CORRECTION (session B, executed): the instruction "delete boost.json before staging" is
WRONG for this repo and must not be followed. `boost.json` is a TRACKED, COMMITTED file here
(`git ls-files --error-unmatch boost.json` succeeds), and this run's `npm run build` did NOT
modify it. Deleting it stages the removal of a real repo file. Likewise `npm run build` did NOT
regenerate CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md on this run - both stayed clean. The ONLY generated churn was
`public/clarity-scout-sw.js`'s APP_VERSION stamp, which checkpoint.sh reverts automatically via

and all 6 chip tokens; zone-manager bundle contains detachZip/selectZip/deselectZip/attachZipHandlers/
detachNotice; manifest.json repoints to theme-DD-xtf5u.css and zone-manager-C1GLqAsg.js.
